evidence_state: Observed values from printed numerical labels in additional 2018 experiments; same apparatus/author as 1991; not blind validation

source.rights: Numerical facts transcribed with source attribution; source paper retained only in ignored research cache. No open redistribution license established for the full paper.

source_title: Supercooled cloud tunnel studies on the growth of branched planar snow crystals below water saturation
source_location: Figure 1, PDF page 2; methods PDF pages 1 and 3
verification: Read source text and visually inspected complete Figure 1 labels at 160 dpi; source file hash retained. These numbers are printed labels, not digitized curve coordinates.
pressure_status: Site annual mean; individual run pressure not reported
temperature_status: Values are the nominal group headings in Figure 1, not exact per-crystal mean temperatures. Figure 2 plots per-crystal temperatures, visibly offset from group headings; use a temperature sensitivity envelope or digitize Figure 2 before claiming exact matched forcing.
humidity_conversion: e = e_si(T) + delta_rho_kg_m3 * R_v * T_K. State saturation convention explicitly; do not mistake delta_rho for fractional ice supersaturation.
limitations: Mass, thickness, fall speed and individual initial shape/mass are not reported for these 13 examples.
Figures select 13 of the 62 accepted experiments; they are not an unbiased population distribution.
The 0.008/0.018 g m-3 figures describe temporal variability of excess vapor density, not pointwise measurement uncertainty or per-case confidence intervals.
Maximum size alone cannot validate mass or geometry.
Do not calibrate to these cases and then label them independent validation.
